item.title: Condolences pour in for SA rapper Bravo Le Roux
item.description: South Africans are mourning the passing on of local rapper Bravo Le Roux, who passed away in Switzerland on 22 January. He was 30. item.title: South African radio presenter Njinji dies
item.description: The South African entertainment industry is mourning the death of radio presenter and former Ukhozi FM host, Njinji, who passed away on 24 January. News of his death sparked an outpouring of tributes on social media, with fellow broadcasters, musicians and media personalities from Durban remembering him as a passionate and influential figure in the city’s radio culture. Former Vuma FM presenter Jacinta Ngobese Zuma posted on social media: “Eish Mfethu ulale ngoxolo.” (Oh brother, rest in peace).

item.title: GEMA to sell Zebralution to DistroKid investor Insight Holdings
item.description: German collecting society GEMA has agreed to sell digital distribution company Zebralution to the US-based investment firm Insight Holdings Group, a key investor in DistroKid. The transaction is subject to regulatory approval. GEMA confirmed that it will sell 100 per cent of Zebralution to Insight Holdings, which invests through its growth equity arm, Insight Partners. item.description: A governance dispute at the Zimbabwe Music Rights Association (ZIMURA) has intensified, with rival board factions issuing conflicting statements and musicians demanding answers amid allegations of misconduct and financial mismanagement. item.title: Namibian TikToker Luiza Fatima builds her musical identity across borders
item.description: By Tendani Mungoni and Sibongile Kobo Namibian TikToker and artist Luiza Fatima is steadily shaping her musical identity with each song she writes and every performance she records.
